name: Akashic Arms and Armor
body:
You have learned how to enhance your veils.

Prerequisite(s): At least 1 veil known with the Enhanced descriptor, character level 5th

Benefit(s): You may treat yourself as having the Craft Magic arms and Armor item creation feat for the purposes of enhancing your veils that contain the Enhanced descriptor.

You may treat your character level as caster levels for determining prerequisites for crafting this way. If you do not meet the prerequisites for the weapon special quality (such as lacking the proper spells to enhance your veil with flaming burst), the DC for enhancing your veil increases by 5 for each prerequisite you do not meet, as normal.
